mentions.name: Chaingenius Lite
mentions.description: This project fine-tunes Gemini 2.5 Flash on EVM blockchain execution structures, aiming to create a compact representation language for EVM executions analogous to how SMILES or SELFIES encode molecules. It uses perplexity combined with PageRank to perform transaction anomaly detection on blockchain executions.
mentions.source_excerpt: Fine tuning Gemini 2.5 flash on EVM Blockchain execution structures and using perplexity with PageRank to perform transaction anomaly detection.
